events.title: Placement Drive
events.description:
Campus Placement Drive is a career-focused recruitment event organized by the Training and Placement Cell of Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering & Technology (SVCET), Thirupachur, Thiruvallur.

The event provides students with an opportunity to interact with and get recruited by Besant Technologies Pvt. Ltd. through the campus recruitment process. It aims to connect talented students with career opportunities, helping them begin their professional journey and build a successful career.
events.venue: Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering & Technology, Thirupachur, Thiruvallur

events.title: Graduation
events.description:
Graduation Day is a special occasion celebrating the academic achievements, dedication, and hard work of graduating students. The event marks an important milestone as students complete their academic journey and prepare to begin their professional careers or pursue higher studies.

The celebration brings together graduating students, faculty members, college management, parents, and guests to honour the achievements of the graduating batch. The programme includes the presentation of degrees, certificates, medals, and awards, along with inspiring speeches and memorable moments.

Graduation Day is a celebration of achievement, growth, and new beginnings, creating lasting memories for students as they take their next step into the future.
events.venue: Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering & Technology, Thirupachur, Thiruvallur

events.title: DIGITRON'26
events.description:
DIGITRON’26 is a National Level Technical Symposium organized by the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering & Technology. The symposium provides students with an exciting platform to demonstrate their technical knowledge, creativity, problem-solving abilities, and innovative ideas through a variety of technical and non-technical events.

The symposium features technical events such as Paper Presentation, Poster Making, Debugging, Tech Quiz, AI Prompt, and Web Development, along with engaging non-technical events including Free Fire, IPL Auction, Guess the Song, Connection, Speed Stacking, Box Cricket, and Puzzle Hunt.
events.venue: Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering & Technology, Thirupachur, Thiruvallur
